speaker: Warden Brenna
text: The Trial Spire, they call it. Old academy magic — you can bleed in there, but you can't die. The tower won't allow it.

speaker: Warden Brenna
text: Climb as high as you dare. Each floor is meaner than the last, and each one it grants back is worth more — extra credit, coin, and steel for those with the spine to reach it.

speaker: Warden Brenna
text: Once a week the spire wakes. Spend that turn well, Kai. It's the fastest way I know to turn a promising student into a dangerous one.
